thread:
clare: Heads-up: new onboarding user hit a crash with samplekit when using JSON mode + fn-calls + schema-strict validator. Repro in 3 steps in the ticket.
aj: what crash do you see?
clare: The SDK helper that validates function output against our JSON schema throws because arguments field is a string after an auth retry. Example captured from logs:
```
{"type":"function_call","name":"refund","arguments":"{\"order_id\":\"ord_9\",\"amount\":10}"}
```
arguments expected object per schema -> validator rejects -> sample app shows generic "invalid response" UX.
maria: sounds similar to earlier double-stringify issues but this one surfaces as a schema validation failure instead of parse fail. Pinged infra to see if retry path re-serializes.
dave: is this only on samplekit or seen in product SDKs too?
clare: reproduced on samplekit and a customer's quickstart. Only on JS so far; py tests pass because transport uses bytes there.
aj: quick debug: our strict schema helper runs JSON.parse on the arguments field only if it's not already an object, but we rely on it being object-shaped. If arguments is a string we try JSON.parse and it succeeds, but downstream our validator expects specific types and fails because some nested fields are strings not numbers (coercion differences).
clare: customer hit this during onboarding and left frustrated. We should provide clearer error messaging and mitigate at SDK level.
aj: proposed fixes: 1) Add a transport guard to avoid double-serializing on retry (same as previous threads), 2) Make schema validator tolerant: try to coerce primitives when safe, but only in a non-strict mode for samplekit/onboarding, 3) Surface an explicit onboarding error when arguments is a string after fn-call in jsonMode.
maria: +1 for targeted tolerance in dev/starter kits. We should not relax validator globally. Add a flag (validator.strict = true/false) so samplekits can opt-in to lenient parsing.
dave: action items: aj -> quick transport guard PR + unit that simulates 401+refresh, clare -> add onboarding-friendly error text in samplekit and the docs, maria -> follow-up on parity audit for python/js transports.
dev-bot: created issue #2043: samplekit-fncall-schema-strict-on-retry, attached CI trace.
clare: I'll draft a small README troubleshooting snippet: 
"If you see a schema validation error for function outputs immediately after an auth refresh, it's likely caused by a retry path double-serializing the request. Workarounds: pin token refresh during onboarding, or update to SDK patch when available." 
aj: will open PR shortly. Thanks all."
